claim_verbatim: Inflationary Violence Copper prices will rise until they destroy demand. This is not a gentle slope; it is a violent correction. Prices must reach a level that forces the cancellation of the lowest-priority activities.
source: Essay: COPPER: LIMITS TO GROWTH IN THE AGE OF DEMAND SIMULTANEITY
resolution_criterion: YES if by end-2028 LME copper makes a new cycle high above Jan-2026 AND documented cancellation/deferral of material copper-intensive civilian projects attributed to copper cost; NO otherwise.
resolution_rule_fixed: YES if by end-2028 LME copper makes a new cycle high above Jan-2026 AND documented cancellation/deferral of material copper-intensive civilian projects attributed to copper cost; NO otherwise.
resolution_source_planned: LME copper; trade press on project cancellations
mechanism: Copper prices will rise until they destroy demand… Likely a hit to housing and consumer goods.

claim_verbatim: The lag in copper supply means that the physical infrastructure required to energize the AI and Green revolutions simply will not be there.
source: Essay: COPPER: LIMITS TO GROWTH IN THE AGE OF DEMAND SIMULTANEITY
resolution_criterion: YES if by end-2028 major official decarbonisation/AI-power build schedules show material shortfalls vs announced copper-intensive targets attributable to copper/material constraints; NO if programmes meet targets on schedule.
resolution_rule_fixed: YES if by end-2028 major official decarbonisation/AI-power build schedules show material shortfalls vs announced copper-intensive targets attributable to copper/material constraints; NO if programmes meet targets on schedule.
notes: Broad; may end unresolved for evidence insufficiency.

claim_verbatim: Complete enforcement of the May 2026 sulphuric acid export halt is the baseline expectation. Any signs of quota easing or political exemptions will immediately signal a bearish reversal for global reagent pricing.
source: Essay: War, El Niño, Pestilence, and Famine
resolution_criterion: YES if Chinese industrial sulphuric acid exports remain halted or near-halted for May–August 2026; NO if exports resume at material scale in that window without one-off framing.
resolution_rule_fixed: YES if Chinese industrial sulphuric acid exports remain halted or near-halted for May–August 2026; NO if exports resume at material scale in that window without one-off framing.
resolution_source_planned: Trade press / customs / Bloomberg shipping data
mechanism: China sulphuric acid export ban as reagent chokepoint.
notes: Halt from ~1 May 2026; first cargo since halt early Sep (after window). Informal ban said through Dec 31.

claim_verbatim: Consequently, the extreme under-application forced by the 2026–2027 crisis guarantees a persistent “yield hangover”, a structural suppression of global agricultural productivity that will extend through 2028 to 2030.
source: Essay: War, El Niño, Pestilence, and Famine
resolution_criterion: YES if FAO/USDA global cereal yield measures for 2028–2030 remain structurally below 2018–2022 trend after area adjustment; NO if yields recover to trend.
resolution_rule_fixed: YES if FAO/USDA global cereal yield measures for 2028–2030 remain structurally below 2018–2022 trend after area adjustment; NO if yields recover to trend.
mechanism: Under-applied fertiliser causes crops to mine residual soil NPK, depleting later yields.

resolution_rule_fixed: YES if UNHCR/IOM or national agencies document sustained elevated irregular migration into Europe and/or North America in late 2026–2027 linked to agricultural/food stress; NO otherwise.
